meta.title: CherryStock ADLC Agent Harness — Agents, Files & Handoffs

views.label: Core ADLC
views.note: Canonical material-change path: route → requirement → design → implementation → independent validation.

views.label: Indicator lifecycle
views.note: Indicator_Management owns metadata/backfill lifecycle and hands IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION to TestEngineer.

views.label: Chart / Flint
views.note: Chart owns recommendation/spec/render; production integration flows to GeneralCoding and then TestEngineer.

views.label: Files & folders
views.note: Stage-aligned repository materials show where each ADLC outcome and execution policy lives.

views.label: Failure routing
views.note: FAIL/REGRESSION returns to the owner of the failed outcome; BLOCKED returns to the dependency owner or user.

cards.title: Shared bootstrap — every routed task
items: 1) .github/copilot-instructions.md — executable router: classify intent, select authoritative owner, preserve handoff/gates.
2) .github/agents/CherryMon.agent.md — architecture constitution: module boundaries, dependency rules and Source-of-Truth principles.
3) Intent-specific .github/agents/*.agent.md — WHO owns the current engineering outcome.
4) Matching .github/instructions/*.instructions.md — HOW that domain must execute safely.
5) docs/00_HOME.md → relevant docs/** → source/tests/runbooks — smallest evidence set needed for the task.

cards.title: BusinessAnalyst.agent.md — requirement readiness
items: Reads governance, CherryMon, docs/00_HOME.md, existing REQ-*, relevant architecture/ADR and domain constraints.
Runs Frame → Define → Make Testable → Decompose/Route.
Writes docs/backlog/requirements/REQ-*.md using REQUIREMENT_TEMPLATE.md.
READY_FOR_DESIGN → SolutionArchitect; READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION → GeneralCoding/domain owner; ambiguity stays with BA.

cards.title: SolutionArchitect.agent.md — design readiness
items: Reads ready REQ-* + docs/architecture/** + docs/adr/** + domain instructions + current source/tests.
Runs Context → Current State → Proposed Design → Decision Check; defines contracts, boundaries, data model, failure and migration behavior.
Writes docs/architecture/**, docs/adr/** when required, Archify typed source and synchronized generated HTML.
Only after Archify validation/synchronization may it emit APPROVED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.

cards.title: Indicator_Management.agent.md — specialist lifecycle
items: Reads docs/architecture/Indicator_Engine.md + .github/instructions/indicators.instructions.md + legacy Indicator_Engine reference + calcEngine source + CherryMon MCP evidence.
Runs Discover → PHASE 1 metadata transaction → PHASE 2 targeted historical backfill → PHASE 3 validation.
Owns dim_indicator, dim_indicator_component, dim_indicator_config and scoped cal_indicator_values lifecycle behavior.
Hands IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION with ConfigIds/evidence to TestEngineer; no self-declared final PASS.

cards.title: Chart.agent.md — visualization decision + Flint
items: Reads .github/instructions/chart.instructions.md + .github/skills/chart-authoring/SKILL.md + docs/architecture/Chart_Architecture.md + actual data contract.
Runs Understand → Recommend → Map to Flint → Transform if needed → Validate → Render/Compile → Sanity Check.
Advisory/spec/render may terminate at the user; production integration hands the chart/data-transform contract to GeneralCoding.
Outcomes include CHART_RECOMMENDATION_READY, CHART_SPEC_READY and CHART_RENDERED.

cards.title: GeneralCoding + TestEngineer — separation of duties
items: GeneralCoding reads the ready request/design + matching instructions; runs Confirm → Inspect → Implement → Update Materials → Developer Verification → Handoff.
Implementation artifacts live primarily in src/**, scripts/** and affected docs/tests; exit is IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION.
TestEngineer reads .github/instructions/testing.instructions.md + requirement/AC + implementation handoff + architecture/domain contracts and uses DEFINE → PREPARE → EXECUTE → EVALUATE.
Only TestEngineer owns PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | REGRESSION; feedback routes requirement gaps→BA, design gaps→SA, defects→implementation/domain owner.

cards.title: Repository folders — purpose by ADLC stage
items: .github/agents/** = outcome ownership; .github/instructions/** = domain execution policy; .github/skills/** = reusable specialist procedures.
docs/backlog/requirements/** = durable requirement contract; docs/architecture/** = design Source of Truth; docs/adr/** = durable cross-module decisions.
src/** = runtime implementation; scripts/** = focused execution/migration/backfill/render helpers; tests/** = executable validation.
docs/runbook/** = reproducible operational/test procedure; docs/ChangeRequest/** = change/release traceability; docs/architecture/generated/** = presentation output only.

cards.title: Fast paths and feedback are routing rules, not extra mandatory stages
items: Clear bounded change: Router → GeneralCoding/domain owner → TestEngineer; BA/SA are skipped when their outcomes are already explicit.
Explicit architecture request may route directly to SolutionArchitect; material ambiguity discovered by SA returns to BA.
Concrete indicator lifecycle routes directly to Indicator_Management; Chart advisory routes directly to Chart.
The Feedback Router node summarizes rework classification; detailed return edges are intentionally omitted to keep the verified workflow readable.
